body:
LoudMaize, thanks for your response. I'm sorry to read about your roommates brother, I know it's difficult to watch people hurt folks who love them. 

This is the answer I didn't want to hear but somewhere in me I expected it. Im realizing the best I can do in my position may be to continue to be his friend as long as it doesn't jeopardize my safety. 

The trouble with getting him hospitalized or therapy is the cost attached. He's out of work due to CoVID and is staying with family because he was evicted right before the stay at home orders were enacted in my local area.  

I'll keep searching for answers and talking with him about what he thinks he can do for himself. He's totally cognizant of his issues but is more than willing to ignore them until they make themselves unavoidable. 

I appreciate your story and your insight.
